CustomField.description: Field Indicate the Current transaction of quote line
CustomField.formula: IF(SBQQ__UpgradedSubscription__c != null || SBQQ__UpgradedAsset__c != null, IF(AND(!NSP_Original_Line__c, SBQQ__Quantity__c == NSP_Previous_Quantity__c),null, IF(NSP_Original_Line__c, 'Amend', IF(SBQQ__Quote__r.NSP_Has_Renewable_Products__c == 0 , IF( SBQQ__Quantity__c > SBQQ__PriorQuantity__c, 'Amend/Upsell', IF(SBQQ__Quantity__c < SBQQ__PriorQuantity__c, 'Amend/Downgrade', '') ) , '') ) ) , IF( AND (SBQQ__Source__c != null,TEXT(NSP_Action_Type__c)!= ''), IF(NSP_Previous_Quantity__c < NSP_Quoted_Quantity__c, 'Upsell', IF(NSP_Previous_Quantity__c > NSP_Quoted_Quantity__c, 'Downgrade', '') ) , 'Add Product') )
CustomField.label: Action Type
